ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast white clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered, discrete circular white focal spots (rosettes) measuring approximately 5-20 pixels in diameter distributed across the lower-medial regions. Linear high-contrast streaks oriented vertically on the right lobe and diagonally on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending approximately 14% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys. Right lobe displays higher-amplitude serrations (peaks up to 15 pixels) with sharp, jagged geometry; left lobe shows more moderate, rounded serration frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning into sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of irregular, circular high-contrast pixels at the extreme distal tips. Isolated, roughly circular pixel clusters scattered across the central surface area of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 10 to 80 pixels in length, primarily visible on the mid-to-lower sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at the distal tips, healed linear rake marks, and numerous circular depigmented scars potentially from previous barnacle attachments or parasitic lesions.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization creates a unique, protruding textured boundary at the extreme distal edges of the fluke, distinct from the organic skin curvature.
